room_rent.note: Policy covers reasonable and customary charges for room rent up to sum insured; no explicit room rent sub-limit stated in schedule of benefits

icu.note: ICU charges covered up to sum insured; no separate ICU sub-limit specified

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-pay applies to all insured persons aged 61 years and above at first entry into Health Absolute policy; continues at all subsequent renewals

sub_limits.note: Cataract: 10% of SI per eye (max ₹75k–₹2L depending on plan); Lasik: ₹30k–₹1L; Bariatric: 50% of SI max ₹5L–₹10L; maternity sub-limits also apply

deductible.note: No compulsory deductible; voluntary deductible available as an option

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 24 months continuous coverage from first inception; no optional reduction mentioned

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month wait for cataract, hernia, BPH, hydrocele, stones, etc.; 36-month wait for rheumatoid arthritis, joint replacement, Lasik, gout, osteoporosis

maternity.note: Inbuilt; 24-month wait if both spouses covered (3 annual premiums), 36-month wait if only female covered (4 annual premiums); sub-limits vary by plan: normal ₹25k–₹1L, caesarean ₹25k–₹2L

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% of SI added per claim-free year; reduces at same rate if claim made; max 100% of SI

restoration.note: Restore SI equal to 100% of base SI triggered on second claim in same policy year; available for same or new illness under sections 2.1–2.4; once per policy year; not for maternity

pre_hosp.note: 60 days pre-hospitalisation cover across all three plans

post_hosp.note: Classic: 90 days; Platinum: 120 days; Signature: 180 days

day_care.note: Extensive listed day-care procedures in Annexure I; also covers any other procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technology advancement

domiciliary.display: Covered (Home Health Care up to 20% of SI)
domiciliary.note: Home Health Care covered up to 20% of SI via empanelled provider on cashless basis; standard domiciliary hospitalisation definition also included

ayush.note: Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy covered on reimbursement basis at registered AYUSH hospitals; OPD AYUSH excluded

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses of organ donor covered up to sum insured; donor screening and pre/post-hospitalisation for donor excluded

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stereotactic radiosurgery, deep brain stimulation, etc.) covered up to sum insured as inpatient or day care

consumables.note: Annexure III lists 67+ non-medical/consumable items excluded; gloves, masks, etc. not payable

global_cover.note: Medical Treatment Abroad available only under Signature plan (SI ₹50L+) after 36 months continuous coverage; limited to 8 specific conditions/surgeries; paid in INR

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days for all modes except monthly premium where grace period is 15 days

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability

portability.note: IRDAI portability applicable for waiting periods; not applicable for maternity, infertility, bariatric surgery continuity

notable_exclusions.display: External congenital anomaly, STDs (non-HIV), stem cell storage, hormone replacement therapy, treatment outside India (except Signature add-on), intentional self-injury

optional_riders.display: Voluntary deductible; Medical Treatment Abroad (Signature plan only, inbuilt after 36 mo); Infertility cover (inbuilt after 36 mo); Bariatric surgery (inbuilt after 36 mo)
